ITEM 1 | Flatbread-style pizza slices, two rectangular pieces, golden-brown crust with charred spots at edges, covered with melted pale cheese, red sauce, dark brown crumbled meat pieces, and thin red onion rings; piece size roughly 10 cm by 6 cm each, moist and slightly oily sheen on cheese | 190
ITEM 2 | Mixed green salad, loose pile of frilly light and dark green leaves, shredded orange carrot strands, sliced cucumber rounds, and dark purple sliced vegetable pieces, slightly glossy with dressing, covering roughly a quarter of the plate, about 8 cm tall mound | 120
ITEM 3 | Diced cooked chicken, cubes about 1.5 cm, pale cream-white with light golden browned edges, slightly dry surface with some seasoning specks, heaped in a pile on the right side of the plate | 110
ITEM 4 | Whole dark purple-black olives, scattered among the salad and chicken, glossy skin, about 2 cm long, around 8 pieces | 35
ITEM 5 | Two triangular wedges of dark brown bread or cake-like slice, crusty top dusted with pale specks of coarse salt or seeds, dense crumb, about 10 cm long per wedge, placed at upper right edge of plate | 90
ITEM 6 | Dressing or sauce residue, thin light sheen on the green leaves and pizza topping, glossy and translucent where it coats the salad | 10
